mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.community_id, c.user_id, u.user_name, c.parent_comment_id, c.content, c.create_date, c.update_date FROM comments c LEFT JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE c.community_id = #{communityId} ORDER BY COALESCE(c.parent_comment_id, c.id) ASC, c.parent_comment_id IS NOT NULL ASC, c.create_date ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comments SET community_id = #{communityId}, user_id = #{userId}, parent_comment_id = #{parentCommentId}, content = #{content}, create_date = NOW()
